Field Descriptions

SDCARD_OVERFLOW - sdcard_overflow

A frame became full while BUFFER_WRITE_READY was not set (SDHCI not ready). ADC stopped. Clear with CLEAR_STATUS.

SDCARD_DONE - sdcard_done

HW copy engine finished the capture's last frame: its CMD25 session completed, AUTO_CMD12 closed it and the card released DAT0, so every block is physically committed. Clear with CLEAR_STATUS.

ADC_OVERFLOW - adc_overflow

ADC CDC FIFO was full when a new sample arrived; at least one sample was dropped. Clear with CLEAR_STATUS.

F1_FULL - Block Fx Full

High if the Fx Block was fully written

F0_FULL - Block Fx Full

High if the Fx Block was fully written
